description: Middle school number fluency and proportional reasoning

cards.back: A prime has exactly two positive factors: 1 and itself.
Greatest common factor is the largest integer that divides each number.
Least common multiple is the smallest positive multiple shared by numbers.
Multiply or divide numerator and denominator by same nonzero number.
Multiply decimal by 100 and add percent sign.
Ratio compares two quantities; rate is a ratio with different units.
Rate per one unit, found by division.
A proportion states two equal ratios, such as a/b = c/d.
Part = percent * whole, with percent as decimal.
Same signs add and keep sign; different signs subtract and keep sign of larger magnitude.
Same signs give positive, different signs give negative.
Absolute value is distance from zero on number line.
Use parentheses, exponents, multiplication/division, then addition/subtraction left to right.
